conversation.content: What are the best strategies to win at online poker?

message.content:
# Key Online Poker Strategies

## Fundamentals
- **Position matters**: Play more hands in late position, fewer in early position
- **Starting hand selection**: Be selective - fold most hands pre-flop
- **Understand pot odds**: Know when the math supports a call
- **Aggression**: Betting and raising is generally stronger than calling

## Bankroll Management
- Never risk more than 5% of your bankroll on a single game
- Move down stakes during losing streaks
- Keep poker funds separate from living expenses

## Table Selection
- Look for tables with weaker players
- Avoid tables full of tight/aggressive regulars when starting out

## Continuous Improvement
- Review your hands using tracking software
- Study training content and hand histories
- Understand GTO (Game Theory Optimal) concepts
- Learn to adapt to different opponent types

## Mental Game
- Avoid "tilt" - don't play emotionally after bad beats
- Take breaks when frustrated
- Stay focused (avoid multi-tasking)

## Practical Tips
- Start at lower stakes to learn
- Focus on one game format initially
- Pay attention to opponent patterns
